text: うみべに　おおく　あらわれ　よるになると　ちゅうしんが　あかく　てんめつする。

structure.jp: うみべに　おおく　あらわれ
structure.en: it appears in large numbers at the seashore, and

structure.jp: ちゅうしんが　あかく　てんめつする。

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever that happens, the next thing follows. よるになると = 'when it becomes night'.

patterns.name: 〜ます-stem (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short to the form that goes before ます works like て in written style, joining on the next part with 'and'. あらわれ = 'it appears, and'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: になる after a thing says 'turn into' that thing. よるになる = 'it becomes night'.
